rules: Observed evidence never becomes approved through copying, unit conversion, majority vote, filename matching, title matching, tags, or collection membership.
Conflicting evidence is preserved by source and physical or commercial state until the named factual owner approves a resolution.
Shopify Admin is authoritative for current commerce configuration, but is not automatically authoritative for engineering, legal, warranty, freight, or compatibility facts.
Legacy and Shopify Files sources are evidence; filename or machine-family association alone does not make them current or authoritative.
A superseded record identifies its replacement; deprecated means retained for audit history and forbidden for new use.

An RH-###### commerce SKU is valid only when allocated through the human-owned Rhino commerce SKU registry; an agent may not create one from catalog attributes, technical facts, Shopify IDs, or relative sort order.

Approved desired-state custom-data definitions come only from the canonical registry, must not duplicate native Shopify fields, and require snapshot-relative reconciliation plus an E-PBI-019 mutation plan before any Admin action.
